name: Notifications
summary: 在不打断当前任务的情况下提供短暂状态反馈。
behavior: 必要时允许用户关闭或暂停
accessibility: 消息可被辅助技术播报
不把关键错误只放在 toast
do: 让消息对应刚完成的操作
dont: 不要用 notification 承载唯一错误解释

en.summary: Provides brief status feedback without interrupting the current task.
behavior: Allow users to close or pause when needed
accessibility: Do not put critical error explanations only in a toast
do: Tie the message to the completed action
dont: Do not use a notification as the only error explanation
